title: LUMEN
style: clean modern product photography, soft diffused daylight, shallow depth of field, matte surfaces, muted natural palette, minimal composition, crisp focus, high detail

music.tags: hopeful rising strings, arpeggiated piano, soft swelling brass, gentle percussion, uplifting, instrumental

beats.prompt: A minimal desk lamp on an empty desk in a dark room, single warm pool of light, clean product photography
beats.caption: Most lamps have one setting

line.text: Most desk lamps have one setting: on.

beats.prompt: The same lamp casting cool bright light across a desk with an open notebook, daytime mood, crisp
beats.motion: The light shifts gradually cooler and brighter.
beats.caption: Cool and bright to think

line.text: LUMEN moves with the day. Cool and bright when you need to think.

beats.prompt: The lamp in warm amber light over a desk in a dark evening room, cosy, shallow focus
beats.motion: The light warms slowly, amber deepening.
beats.caption: Warm and low to stop

line.text: Warm and low when you need to stop.

beats.prompt: A hand switching the lamp off, room going dark except for a window, calm, cinematic
beats.motion: The light fades out. The window glows faintly.
beats.caption: LUMEN - light that knows the hour

line.text: LUMEN. Light that knows what time it is.
